items.title: Report from the OpenAI hackathon
items.summary: On March 3rd, we hosted our first hackathon with 100 members of the artificial intelligence community.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI举办了首次黑客马拉松，邀请了100名人工智能社区成员参与。此次活动旨在促进社区交流与技术探讨。
